records.title: South Wales Echo, 21 Jan 1989, p.2: court report (William Buckler)
records.summary: Court report. It names Mr Buckler as having lived at Tŷ Mawr (Great House), Llandough, until BP Properties demolished it late in 1988, and concerns a charge relating to an incident at Llandough on 29 April [1988]. The prosecution opening follows. The snippet wording is not quoted here; the full report has not been read. (search-result preview; full page not seen)

records.title: South Wales Echo, 23 Mar 1989, p.4: report on legal proceedings (William Buckler)
records.summary: Report that Mr Buckler was taking legal proceedings against BP Properties, the police, the Vale of Glamorgan Borough Council and Llandough Community Council over damage to property, furniture and personal possessions. A second search pass (11 Mar to 15 Apr 1989) returned these words from the 23 Mar p.4 or the 24 Mar p.6 report (which of the two was not recorded): “in the process of making a deal with BP Properties over compensation [to] vacate Great House Farm” and “We had no warning they were going to enforce possession”. Same date as EV-0120 (“Evicted farmer freed after pleading guilty”, page not recorded); whether this passage is part of that report is not checked. (search-result preview; full page not seen)
